review_response_tasks.stem: The figures in the final report must be a________ (准确的), so please check them again.
The club hopes to r________ (减少) the amount of paper used in its weekly notices.
review_response_tasks.rationale: to后接原形reduce，减少amount不是把所有纸移除；reduction不合动词位置。

review_response_tasks.stem: Each team member is r________ (负责的) for checking one part of the display.
review_response_tasks.rationale: be responsible for为承担责任的搭配；responsibility不能直接作此形容词表语。

review_response_tasks.stem: Living away from home helped her become more i________ (独立的) in making everyday decisions.
review_response_tasks.rationale: more后用形容词independent，independence是名词；此句说日常决策能力。

review_response_tasks.stem: The visit is on our s________ (日程安排), but the starting time has not been confirmed.
review_response_tasks.rationale: on our schedule表示已列入日程；拼写schedule，非只填写缺失后缀。

review_response_tasks.stem: Keeping a clear record is e________ (必不可少的) when several people share the same equipment.
review_response_tasks.rationale: is后用essential形容词，essence不是同一语法形式。

review_response_tasks.stem: The designer offered a p________ (切实可行的) way to repair the stand using tools we already had.
review_response_tasks.rationale: practical修饰way并由现成工具的可实施性支撑；practically不修饰名词way。

review_response_tasks.stem: We cannot accept more than forty visitors. Forty is the m________ (最大限度).
review_response_tasks.rationale: 定冠词后作上限名词maximum；minimum意为下限，与cannot accept more than不合。

review_response_tasks.stem: The teacher demonstrated a new m________ (方法) for organising the interview notes.
review_response_tasks.rationale: a new后接单数method，for说明方法用途；不同语义的manner或means须按完整语境复核，参考集合未认证穷尽。

review_response_tasks.stem: Completing the first exhibition together was an important a________ (成就) for the new club.
review_response_tasks.rationale: 两词均为a开头可数成就名词，an important后单数，均与完成首次展览相容。
